summary: IT Director/Manager with extensive experience in network operations, leveraging expertise in organization growth and problem solving. Driven, professional and detailed-oriented with the proven ability to plan, design and implement technical systems, improve process flow and administer departmental budgets.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Managed IT operations for a commercial real estate investment company with 15+ U.S. locations
Forecasted and planned network information processing and communication needs
Provided senior‑level leadership on IT security and risk management
Ensured compliance with SOX, PCI, IT general and regulatory controls
Developed and administered IT operational policies and procedures
Created and analyzed annual IT operational and capital budgets and 5‑year plans
Inspected, evaluated, and negotiated third‑party contracts for software and hardware services
Led disaster recovery and business continuity planning
Implemented network redundancy and failover using BGP
Enforced standards for software rollouts and maintained application consistency
Managed document imaging system for record retention
Upgraded audio/video in conference rooms and installed office security systems
Hired and supervised system administrators and outside consultants

experience.title: Manager of Information Technologies
responsibilities: Performed network administration, PC and network troubleshooting
Configured file servers and backup systems
Managed network and switch operations
Maintained Lotus Notes Domino mail server and upgraded OS and applications
Handled anti‑virus and firewall management
Configured and troubleshot hardware
Maintained application administration

experience.title: Sole IT Person / Manager of Information Services
responsibilities: Ran accounting operations system and later served as Network Manager
Maintained UNIX and Novell servers

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
responsibilities: Provided technical support for customers
